== Summary ==
Japanese [[Snowtrooper Officer (Japanese)|Snowtrooper Officer]] with a blank title strip. Crop of the embedded photograph on collecting encyclopedia p. 48, xref 2100. Original pixels retained at native size.<ref name="missing-title-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Crop rectangle (left, top, right, bottom): <code>(617, 5, 1218, 842)</code>. Image SHA-256: <code>c84822f05195d31741b5019ed44e8504e011dd2b6972a14a42c905ed50c6c903</code>. The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
